notes.title: Diner Bros 2 is here!
notes.notes: [p]In 2018, we served up the very first orders in Diner Bros.  From shouting pizza orders at our buddies to barely surviving the taco rush, we made some great memories.[/p][p]Now, 7 long years later...[/p][h2]THE BROS ARE BACK![/h2][h3]Diner Bros 2 is now available on Steam! [/h3][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253150/Diner_Bros_2/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3253150/Diner_Bros_2/[/url][/p][p]Featuring:[/p][list][*][p]All new restaurants[/p][/*][*][p]Customizable layouts[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh recipes[/p][/*][*][p]Returning local co-op madness[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Grab it for the launch discounted price of $9.99 (Quick, before the discount expires!)[/b][/p][p]To all the original Diner Bros players: Thanks for sticking around! Let's make new memories in Diner Bros 2![/p][p]PS: There's a Food Critic fridge magnet giveaway happening on the Discord: [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Azb8Ee3gSr"]https://discord.gg/Azb8Ee3gSr[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32619230/34f5eabcb1e1a3f793a6bd051c3c4a3566eb29f9.png"][/img][/p]

Local co-op with up to 4 players is also available and can be played via Remote Play.[/p][p]Give it a shot and please share your feedback in the Diner Bros community hub or on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FAzb8Ee3gSr"]Discord[/url]. notes.title: Now Available: Diner Bros Inc!
notes.notes:
The day has come: [b]Diner Bros Inc[/b] releases today! Prepare to defend your restaurant from all kinds of crazy threats in this new local multiplayer party game. Diner Bros Inc will pit you against your friends in a frantic competition of minigames. As you beat them, their difficulty and speed will keep increasing, and miniboss levels will challenge your skills in a breath-taking and heart-stopping competition.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733480/Diner_Bros_Inc/]Get Diner Bros Inc Now![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32619230/07eea142e8aab5b3a371a804f70700014ec921ff.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who submitted their high scores in the [url=https://discord.gg/Azb8Ee3gSr]Discord[/url].  We got some really high scores (300 to 400+)! I've seen some Youtube videos of record endless runs and it was neat seeing the different strategies (e.x. not cleaning up plates!).  I look forward to seeing what you guys do for high scores in Diner Bros Inc!

[i]Get [b]Diner Bros Inc[/b] on Steam now -- and remember that if you like the game you can help us by spreading the word about the game on social media, and reviewing it here on Steam! [/i]

notes.title: High Score Contest: Win a copy of my New Game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32619230/07eea142e8aab5b3a371a804f70700014ec921ff.png[/img]

Hello chefs! After all these months, I'm back with good news... I'm releasing a brand-new game starring our favorite bros: [b]DINER BROS INC[/b]!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733480/Diner_Bros_Inc/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733480/Diner_Bros_Inc/[/url]

Diner Bros INC is a frantic local-multiplayer party game for up to 4 players, and you can choose to cooperate (sharing your lives) or compete (only the best will survive!). In order to save our favorite diner from a mysterious villain, you'll have to beat sequences of varied minigames in quick succession! And by varied I really mean varied! One moment you'll be giving haircuts, going shopping or playing cards, while the next moment you might be fighting aliens, becoming an archer or smashing cars with your own fists!

And to celebrate the launch of this new game, I've organized a Diner Bros high score contest on Discord. If you participate, you'll get a chance to win a Steam Key for the new game!

The contest starts now and will end on [b]September 6, 2021[/b], the day Diner Bros INC is released. To participate you just need to play Diner Bros and share a screenshot of your game-over score on our Discord, in one of these channels:

#endless-burger
#endless-pizza
#endless-sushi
#endless-tacos
#endless-zombieees

You can join our Discord here: [url=https://discord.gg/Azb8Ee3gSr]https://discord.gg/Azb8Ee3gSr[/url]

We will pick random winners from all those who participate. Good luck chefs!

notes.title: Did you like your dinner? Review Diner Bros!
notes.notes: Good day chefs! Any diner lives and dies by its clients' opinion, the proverbial word of mouth. Diner Bros is no different: we wouldn't be busy in the kitchen if not for you, your passion, and your feedback. [b]Reviews are a great way to help a game, especially an indie game.[/b] If you liked the game, a good review not only gives us extra motivation but also helps to spread the word around. If you didn't like it, your constructive criticism will help us to improve and grow. In any case, if you want to lend us a hand[b], spend a couple of minutes leaving us your review. [/b]And of course, a huge[b] thank you to everyone who already reviewed Diner Bros! [/b]

notes.title: Korean Localization and Hardcore Levels
notes.notes:
Good day chefs! We've been busy in the kitchen for a few weeks, and we're happy to bring some new and tasty content to your tables: today Diner Bros receives a new update! The first thing we want to announce is that now Diner Bros is fully localized to Korean! Korean gamers have supported us since its release, and we wanted to give back some of that love. To all our players from there: 고맙습니다! We're also adding a fan-made Czech translation; huge kudos and thanks to its author, David Koncivny!

But that's not all, folks! For those of you who have tested your skills with the knife and pan by impressing all the critics and beating both the campaign and the Challenge Level, here you have 2 new hardcore levels that will put your cool, skill, and reflexes to a test. Good luck with them -- you're going to need it... but as they say, if you can't stand the heat, get out of the kitchen! 

There are some other changes in this update, such as a new secret achievement and some quality-of-life fixes. You will find a comprehensive list below. Enjoy the update, and bon appétit!

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]5 New Challenge Levels![/b] Including 2 hardcore levels
[*][b]New Achievement:[/b] Triple Chop [Secret]
[*][b]New Languages:[/b] Korean, Czech (Fan Translation)
[/list]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Increased difficulty of "Quadathlon" and "King of Punks"
[*]Reduced frequency of Divas in campaign and endless mode
[*]Larger hitbox on Punks (Should make it easier to catch them!)
[/list]
[h1][b]FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]The endless mode achievements will now correctly unlock ("Is that all?" and "I ain't even tired").  If you have already met the requirements, start and finish an endless game with any score to unlock them.
[*]Fixed character select screen freeze that would occur with multiple controllers
[*]The message "The Critic was not Impressed" will now correctly show up
[*]Fixed inverted DPad for multiple controllers
[*]Starting a new game in easy mode will now correctly set the game's difficulty
[/list]

notes.title: Monthversary Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32619230/ef3dd9cb6e8d0e5f07bf37c9d59ff5d9d253fe19.jpg[/img]

Good day chefs! It's been one month since we released Diner Bros, and we want to thank you all for your support. But as we told you when we opened the doors of this restaurant, opening day was but the first step on a long journey for a game that will keep growing and receiving new content over the next months. To celebrate the first month on Steam, we're releasing today our [b]Monthversary Update[/b] with new features, such as 11 new challenge levels, a new Special Costumer, a new Endless Mode, and many new achievements -- along with some quality of life fixes and changes. Check out the full patch notes below. And to mark this occasion, we're happy to announce that [b]Diner Bros will be -10% off[/b] for a few days. Bon appétit!

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*][b]11 New Challenge Levels![/b] Now including HARDCORE levels
[*][b]New Special Customer![/b] The Diva will begin visiting after obtaining 2 stars
[*][b]Endless Mode![/b] How long can you last? Unlocked after obtaining 3 stars
[*][b]The Burger Trophy![/b] Can be purchased after obtaining 3 stars
[*][b]Auto-run![/b] Activate this feature in the Options Menu
[*][b]New Achievements:[/b]
[list]
     [*]Diva Tantrum
     [*]Keep 'em coming!
     [*]Is that all?
     [*]I ain't even tired!
     [*]Challenge III
     [*]The Golden Burger (Secret!)
[/list]
[/list]
[h1][b]CHANGES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The Artist:[/b]
[list]
     [*]The Old Artist behavior has been assigned to the Diva.  The New Artist will now arrive part way through the 2 star restaurant with a new behavior.
     [*]The Diva/Old Artist patience has been increased
     [*]The Diva/Old Artist will no longer order "Chicken and Fries"
[/list]
[*][b]Challenge Mode:[/b]
[list]
     [*]Now playable solo.  Solo players have a faster sprint and can hold multiple items.  Levels marked as "2+" are still co-op only.
     [*]Increased difficulty (Challenge mode should be challenging!)
[/list]
[*][b]Food Critic:[/b]
[list]
     [*]Will now be satisfied if his order is completed (Previously, he had to be served quickly leading to difficulty in the final stages)
     [*]Arrives slightly earlier
[/list]
[*]Updated achievement icons
[/list]
[h1][b]FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]

Hello, chefs!

We are super excited to be opening the kitchen of [b]Diner Bros[/b] in a few days, that's why, today, we wanted to show you a new special customer: the construction worker.

Working in a construction site is an extremely physical job. You need to be fully fit in order to carry construction materials all over the place. Those houses aren't gonna build by themselves, right? And with a physical job, comes a very hungry customer. 

That's why the construction worker will suppose an extra challenge for your kitchen. He will always [b]ask for a double meal[/b] so you'll have to work twice as hard, and twice as fast, to keep him happy. Will you be ready to the task?

Running a restaurant can be a stressful job. Cooking all the meals in time, keeping your customers happy, making sure that everything works flawlessly... If you manage to do it, you will gain fame over time and everybody will want to come to that new joint in the city that everybody is talking about.

But, be careful! In Diner Bros, you'lkl have to be alert when new customers come to your place. One of them is the [b]dishonest customer[/b], a person that will not hesitate to leave your joint without having paid his bill. How can you avoid this situation? You'll have to keep an eye on them and be ready to catch them if they leave without paying. And you need to be quick! Because if they leave the restaurant, you'll have lost your chance to get paid.

Let's not forget that having a dishonest customer at your restaurant won't free you from your [b]other duties[/b]: cooking meals and serving them to your customers in time. Will you be up to the task?

notes.title: Co-op Kitchen Action with The Diner Bros
notes.notes:
I’ve been hard at work for a year and I’m so excited to finally share my project with the world. Now introducing The Diner Bros; a hectic restaurant management game for 1-4 players in couch co-op.  Join the Diner Bros as they cook, serve, and upgrade their restaurant! Your restaurant will initially start off small but by impressing your customers, buying new recipes, and renovating the building, you'll have a bustling hot spot attracting customers from around the city. Keep an eye out for special customers too!

My inspiration to create this game is the enjoyable times playing couch co-op with my friends and family. It felt like there was a long drought of local multiplayer experiences with the removal of split-screen mode from AAA games but in recent years there has been a resurgence of local co-op games.  My goal with Diner Bros is to recreate that enjoyable social experience I've had sitting side-by-side with my friends.

I’m always on the lookout for co-op games to play but many of them are too complex for my non-gamer friends. My main goal has been to balance the gameplay so that it can be enjoyed by players of all skill levels. If you and your partner are competitive and want to maximize your profits, you can do exactly that. Plan out what food will be ordered and prepare the food in advance to earn the most tips. The game will ramp up the difficulty quickly if you choose to play this way. Alternatively, if your partner is more of a casual player, the game will not punish you for it. I’ve found during play testing that the casual player can stick to bussing tables which is a role that only requires good communication. It is important to me to get this balance right as it is very satisfying watching someone who “Doesn’t play video games” and have them enjoy my game.

I am so excited to be working on this project and hope you will enjoy it too. Stay tuned for more updates and thanks for reading!
